steps.name: Verify setup artifacts
steps.run:
test -d backend/venv
test -f backend/.env
test -d frontend-nextjs/node_modules
test -f frontend-nextjs/.env.local
grep -q "SECRET_KEY=" backend/.env
echo "Quickstart artifacts OK"

steps.name: Boot the full app from the generated env
steps.run:
source venv/bin/activate
python -m uvicorn main_api_app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8001 > /tmp/quickstart-backend.log 2>&1 &
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
  curl -fs http://127.0.0.1:8001/alive > /dev/null 2>&1 && { echo "Backend alive from quickstart env"; exit 0; }
  sleep 2
done
echo "Backend failed to boot from quickstart env:"; tail -40 /tmp/quickstart-backend.log; exit 1
